extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: snowmobile, approx. 3.0 x 1.2 x 1.3 m (L x W x H incl. windshield), track width 0.38 m
extras.notes: front faces -Y; rubber track (snowmobile_track) is a separate object with its own tread texture (scroll the UV along U to animate); left and right skis (snowmobile_ski_l/_r) have their origin on the steering spindle, rotate around local Z to steer; handlebar (snowmobile_handlebar) has its origin on the steering post; no brand, no text

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
